text:
ana: quick async follow-up from the INC-345 postmortem — we confirmed a TTL rollout correlated with recurring cache evictions. Goal: ownered runbook edits, a safe canary/runbook checklist, and an automated escalation for repeated incidents. no meeting unless blockers.
sasha: I can own the playbook wording and the automation rule (escalate after N=2 incidents within 7 days). Will add a sample pager payload and the exact alert query.
maya: Ian own the runbook PR and include the config diff + diagnostic commands + a one-line rollback. target: 48h. I'll also add a short QA test plan.
omar: I'll take the canary rollout and verification checklist. Proposal: 3% canary, observe 15m windows for at least 2 consecutive windows, then 25% for 2h before full ramp. I'll add kubectl and traffic-shift commands.
katie-cs: product/support wants a 2-sentence user-facing blurb (what changed, expected impact, rollback plan). I'll draft after runbook PR lands and circle PM.
ops-bot: Created follow-up tasks INC-345-FU-A1 (owner: maya), INC-345-FU-A2 (owner: omar), INC-345-FU-A3 (owner: sasha). Links: https://tracker/INC-345-FU-A1, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-A2, https://tracker/INC-345-FU-A3 :white_check_mark:
maya: Adding diagnostic snippets to the runbook now (will paste exact outputs in PR):
```
# eviction rate (PromQL)
curl -s "http://metrics.internal/api/v1/query?query=rate(cache_evictions_total[5m])" | jq .data.result
# scan keys and TTLs efficiently
redis-cli -h cache.prod --scan --pattern 'session:*' | while read k; do printf "%s\t%s\n" "$k" "$(redis-cli -h cache.prod ttl $k)"; done | sort -k2 -n | head -n 30
# identify top writers to cache in last 10m from logs
curl -s "http://logs.internal/search?query=cache.set+|+top(10)" | jq .results
```
omar: Canary/shutdown commands I'll add to the checklist:
```
# label canary nodes and move a subset of traffic
kubectl -n infra patch svc/cache-proxy -p '{"spec": {"selector": {"canary": "true"}}}'
# progressively move weight: file contains 3/100, then 25/100
kubectl -n infra apply -f k8s/canary-weight-3.yaml
# monitor with this Grafana query (p95)
rate(cache_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m]) -> p95_calc_query
```
sasha: Automation idea: add a lightweight rule that runs nightly to detect "repeat eviction" incidents. If the same cluster has >=2 eviction incidents in 7 days, auto-create a recurring-review ticket, and page oncall-sre + oncall-platform. Sample pager payload for runbook: "[INC-345-RECUR] cluster X has 2 eviction events in 7d -> paging oncall-sre". I'll include the PromQL that should trigger the alert.
katie-cs: Draft support blurb (first pass): "We are adjusting internal cache TTL behavior to reduce unnecessary evictions. No user-visible downtime expected. If a rollback is required we will revert the flag and restore cache config; we will notify affected customers." I'll tighten after the PR. :pencil2:
ops-bot: Reminder set: follow-up check-in in 5 days for INC-345-FU-A1.
nana: small correction: reopen thread if blockers; otherwise we'll close after canary verification.
nana: recap of action items and owners + due dates:
- INC-345-FU-A1 (maya): runbook PR + config diff + diag + rollback snippet (due in 48h)
- INC-345-FU-A2 (omar): canary rollout + checklist + observability queries (canary in 3 business days)
- INC-345-FU-A3 (sasha): playbook automation rule + sample pager + escalation wording (due EOD Fri)
ops-bot: Tickets updated with due dates and owners.
nana: thanks all 4C6 (no meeting unless blockers).
